name: clipboard.get
description: Read the current text contents of the system clipboard. Returns ERR empty if the clipboard has no text.

format.description: Only `text` is defined today. Reserved for future formats (`image`, `files`) which would be wire-additive enum extensions.

content.description: UTF-8 text content of the clipboard.

format.description: Echo of the format that was retrieved.

x-implementations.name: open_clipboard_unicode
x-implementations.description: Win32 `OpenClipboard` + `GetClipboardData(CF_UNICODETEXT)` + `CloseClipboard`. UTF-16 native, transcoded to UTF-8 for the wire response.

x-implementations.name: open_clipboard_ansi
x-implementations.description: Win32 `OpenClipboard` + `GetClipboardData(CF_TEXT)` legacy fallback. Used when the publishing app only set CF_TEXT (common for pre-NT-5 apps); agent transcodes from the active code page to UTF-8.

windows-modern.description: OpenClipboard + GetClipboardData(CF_UNICODETEXT). UTF-16 native, transcoded to UTF-8 for the wire. ERR empty when the clipboard has no CF_UNICODETEXT slot; ERR permission_denied when another app holds the clipboard open (transient — caller can retry).

windows-classic.description: OpenClipboard / GetClipboardData. CF_UNICODETEXT preferred (available since NT 3.1); falls back to CF_TEXT for apps that only publish ANSI. Agent transcodes from the active code page when falling back.
